import subprocess,difflib

findings.title: Update executable plans to use the hardened publication-gate contract
findings.trigger: An executor follows the prescribed hand-review format, or follows Task 3's instruction to recreate both scripts verbatim.
findings.execution_path: Plans 86-03, 86-04, 86-06, 86-07 and 86-10 explicitly reference this format. It omits the SHA-256 required by the committed gate. Task 3 additionally instructs the executor to overwrite both scripts with the embedded older implementations and verify the old 23-case result.
findings.consequence: Following the documented exception procedure blocks publication even for an accepted benign hit. Recreating the scripts instead removes the current hash binding, index/worktree comparison, untracked-file and symlink protections, together with their regression tests.
findings.evidence: Executed the AWK parsers extracted from the embedded plan and committed script against the same plan-prescribed entry. The embedded parser accepted it (exit 0); the committed parser rejected it (exit 1). The embedded script differs from the committed script. Lines 261-266 still require verbatim recreation and the obsolete self-test result.
findings.suggested_fix: Make the committed scripts the authoritative implementation. Remove or update the obsolete embedded copies and fixed test count, and update all referencing plans to prescribe the current hash-bound entry format.
findings.reproduction_command: python3 -c 'import pathlib,re,subprocess,os; d=pathlib.Path(".planning/phases/86-pilot-reference-record"); q=chr(39); entry="## Credential-shape hand review\n- `example.txt`: not a credential -- fixture identifier\n"; env=dict(os.environ,X="example.txt",S="Credential-shape hand review",H="a"*64,D="not a credential -- "); sources=[("plan",(d/"86-01-PLAN.md").read_text()),("gate",(d/"86-publication-gate.sh").read_text())]; [(print(name,subprocess.run(["awk",re.search("awk "+q+"(.*?)"+q+" ",source,re.S).group(1)],input=entry,text=True,env=env).returncode)) for name,source in sources]'
